images.desc: 原创系列：手枪握式手持扫描仪直立，深炮铜机身顶部一片宽平传感头，传感面下射一扇暖琥珀细光束，在下方地面投出一个抽象物件的小小浮像，握把缠棱纹橡胶，侧面一枚琥珀状态灯，底部拖一卷短线，器身带使用磨痕，器械图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: a pistol-gripped handheld scanner held upright, dark gunmetal body with a wide flat sensor head at the top, the sensor face emitting a fan of thin scanning light beams in warm amber projecting downward onto a small floating rendered image of an abstract object, ribbed rubber grip, a small amber status light on the side, a short coiled cable trailing from the base, the body scuffed with use, device catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 反重力平台 · 奇械科技
images.desc: 原创系列：宽平六角拉丝钢平台悬于地面之上，底面环列三只均匀分布的发射喷口泛稳定青光，一道柔和青光垫从喷口铺向地面，台面覆浅凸网格纹，中央一个圆形凹口，钢边磨损微凹，光垫里漂着细微尘埃，器械图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: a broad flat hexagonal platform of brushed steel hovering a short distance above the ground, its underside ringed with three evenly spaced emitter nozzles glowing a steady teal, a soft cushion of teal light spreading down from the nozzles onto the ground, the platform surface covered with a shallow raised grid pattern and a single circular recessed port at its centre, steel edges worn and slightly dented, dust particles drifting in the light cushion, device catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 便携力场发生器 · 奇械科技
images.desc: 原创系列：矮壮便携发生器取深板岩复合材料立于四短脚，顶部穹顶发射器向上一拢，罩住上半身的半球形淡绿透明力场，场表荡着细密同心涟漪，器身三处散热口泛浅绿光，顶上一道厚重提手，外壳磕凹带使用包浆，场沿接地处积一小滩绿光，器械图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: a stubby portable generator of dark slate composite material on four short feet, a domed emitter on top projecting a broad translucent hemispherical force field of pale lime green light surrounding the upper part of the device, the field rippling with faint concentric distortion rings, three cooling vents glowing faint lime on the sides, a heavy carry handle arched over the top, the body dented and scratched with a patina of use, a small pool of green light where the field meets the ground, device catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 折光伏击者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：无眼无面的伏击型掠食者。躯干是一叠竖向折起的半透明硅质晶板，边缘泛油膜般虹彩而中心近乎透明，像一枚收拢待发的弹簧陷阱；三条反关节长腿撑起身体，趾爪张开，基部由数根苍白须根锚进地面；肩部伸出一根细柄，末端垂着一枚多棱面琥珀诱饵果，正滴落一滴黏液。体表干燥、纸质、矿物感，绝不湿滑。骨白、灰烬、虹彩与病态琥珀四色。异星生物图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: an eyeless faceless ambush predator. Its torso is a vertical accordion-fold of translucent crystalline silica plates, edges shimmering with oil-slick iridescence while the centre stays almost invisible, held compact like a cocked spring trap. Three long reverse-jointed legs brace the body, toes splayed, anchored to the ground by pale tendril roots. A slender stalk rises from the shoulder, ending in a faceted amber lure-fruit dripping a single sticky drop. Texture is dry, papery and mineral, never slimy. Bone white, ash grey, iridescent film and sickly amber. Alien creature catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 鸣骨吸附者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：扁平如鳐的寄生型掠食者。身体由一具敞开的螺旋状湿骨肋笼构成——十二根肋骨自中央铰点向外旋出而非对称弯曲，每根肋骨末端环生一圈细小吸盘，肋骨能像手指那样屈伸抓握；无口、无眼、无面。螺旋中心悬着一片共振膜，淤紫半透明，可见同心波纹在膜上荡开；腹面是布满毛细孔的多孔海绵层。质感是湿骨、软骨与潮膜。蜡黄象牙、淤紫膜、锈褐污渍三色。异星生物图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: a parasitic predator flattened like a stingray. Its body is an open spiral cage of wet yellowed bone: twelve ribs spiralling outward from a central hinge instead of curving symmetrically, each rib tipped with a ring of tiny suction pores, the ribs articulating like fingers to grip and walk. No mouth, no eyes, no face. A resonant membrane hangs at the centre of the spiral, bruised violet and translucent, with concentric ripples visibly spreading across it; the underside is a porous sponge of capillary pores. Texture of wet bone, gristle and damp membrane. Jaundiced ivory, bruised violet and rust-brown stains. Alien creature catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 孢丝织者 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：低伏蹲踞的真菌型掠食者，三足反关节，没有头。本该是脸的位置，一枚孢囊裂成五片湿毡质瓣，瓣缝间藏着一簇细小的珠状眼。肩部不生手臂而是两束苍白菌丝，正甩出孢丝，其中一束末端缠着一只拳头大小的猎物茧，丝线正往茧缝里钻。背部覆满会搏动的细纤毛与潮湿菌毡，撒着淡紫孢子粉。质感是湿毡、菌丝与湿土。白垩、湿板岩灰、淡紫孢子粉与一颗湿琥珀珠。异星生物图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: a hunched low-slung fungal predator, tripedal and reverse-jointed, with no head. Where a face would be, a spore sac splits open into five flaps of wet felt, a cluster of small bead-like eyes hidden in the seams between them. Instead of arms, two bundles of pale hyphae extend from the shoulders, mid-casting; one thread ends in a fist-sized prey cocoon, the filaments visibly sinking into its seams. Its back is covered in pulsing fine cilia and damp mycelial felt, dusted with lilac spore powder. Texture of wet felt, mycelium and damp soil. Chalk white, wet slate grey, lilac dust and one wet amber bead. Alien creature catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 脉孢囊壶 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：异星食人植物。一根粗壮的肉质柄自一团根瘤隆起，顶端是一枚半透明囊壶，壶身一道竖直的括约肌式裂缝半开着；壶内可见猎物的半溶解残影悬在琥珀色消化液中，壶壁上爬着搏动的脉管；三根僵硬的倒刺须像护肋那样拱在壶顶，光合质地的墨绿蜡光。整株像在呼吸，壶壁微微鼓胀。无花、无瓣、无叶。墨绿、半透明琥珀与蜡黄脉管三色。异星植被图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: an alien carnivorous plant. A thick fleshy stalk rises from a burl of root-nodes and ends in a translucent bladder-pod with a vertical sphincter slit, half-open. Inside the pod, half-dissolved prey remains hang as dark silhouettes suspended in amber digestive fluid, and pulsing veins crawl across the pod wall. Three stiff barbed tendrils arch over the pod like protective ribs, photosynthetic and green-black with a waxy sheen. The whole plant appears to breathe, the pod walls slightly distended. No flowers, no petals, no leaves. Green-black, translucent amber and jaundiced yellow veins. Alien flora catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 血蕊诱桩 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：异星食人植物。一根硬直的柄，外表像昆虫胸板那样分节，自浅根瘤升起，顶端是一枚多棱面琥珀腺果，正往下淌着浓稠的诱引液，沿柄凝成一道道硬化的流痕；基座周围六根僵硬的光合须向内勾着倒刺，每根须尖有一个小孔，正呼出淡淡可见的蒸汽。无花、无瓣、无叶，柄身微妙地像一根饲管。骨白、钙化米白、琥珀腺果与墨绿倒刺。异星植被图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: an alien carnivorous lure-plant. A tall rigid stalk, ribbed like an insect sternum, rises from a shallow burl of root-nodes and ends in a faceted amber gland-fruit that weeps thick glistening attractant down the stalk in hardened rivulets. Around the base, six stiff photosynthetic tendrils bristle with inward-curving barbs, each tipped with a tiny pore exhaling a faint visible vapor. No flowers, no petals, no leaves; the stalk subtly resembles a feeding tube. Bone, calcified off-white, amber gland and black-green barbs. Alien flora catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 折光出击 · 异星猎食
images.desc: 原创系列：捕食瞬间。折光伏击者自收拢姿态向上弹开，半透明晶板叠成的躯干伸到静止时的两倍长，板片张开把光折射成一圈圈油膜光带；三条反关节腿死死撑住，趾爪张开抓地；肩柄上的琥珀诱饵果甩到前方，柄腱绷直，正滴落黏液；一圈折射激波环在伸长的躯干外围扩散。无眼、无面、无口。干燥纸质的矿物质感。骨白、灰烬、虹彩与琥珀。异星生物图鉴风，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Original series: the moment of the strike. The prism stalker has unfolded upward from its cocked posture, its accordion torso of translucent crystalline plates extended to twice its resting length, the plates splayed and refracting light into bands of oil-slick colour. Its three reverse-jointed legs brace hard, toes splayed and gripping. The amber lure-fruit on its shoulder stalk swings forward, snapped taut on a strained tendon, dripping. A shock-ring of refracted light spreads around the extended torso. No eyes, no face, no mouth. Dry papery mineral texture. Bone white, ash grey, iridescent film and amber. Alien creature catalogue style, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.descEn: A weird instrument: a harp framed with the rib bones of a deep-sea fish, its skull as the resonator, sinew strings, seashells and driftwood beads hanging below, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 触手风琴 · 古怪乐器

images.descEn: A weird instrument: a pipe organ whose eight pipes are eight living octopus tentacles with brass suckers, faint teal glow seeping from the pipe openings when the bellows swell, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 晶皮鼓 · 古怪乐器

images.descEn: A weird instrument: a frame drum with a translucent amber crystal skin, a warm pulse of light rippling under the membrane with every beat, concentric runes carved on the rim, leather cords drawn tight through bone pegs, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 扭力弩炮 · 物理武器

images.descEn: A physics weapon: no magic, just rope force, two twisted rope skeins as torsion springs, iron-banded oak frame, an iron-tipped bolt loaded on the track, winch handle still in place, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 弹簧拳套 · 物理武器

images.descEn: A physics weapon: a purely mechanical power glove, brass-knuckle fist, two thick steel springs and piston rods mounted on the back of the hand, punch speed comes from spring rebound alone, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.descEn: A physics weapon: a medieval flail, an iron ball the size of a bowl studded with square pyramid spikes, heavy chain links to an iron-collared wooden haft wrapped with a leather grip, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 麻袋头 · 变异稻草人

images.name: 鸦骨 · 变异稻草人

images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a bare crow skull for a head, glossy black feathers piercing through the straw-stuffed shirt, sharp talon hands, draped in a tattered black cloak, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 向日葵藤 · 变异稻草人

images.descEn: A mutant scarecrow: a lopsided blooming sunflower for a head with wilting petals, twisting green vines for arms with thorny twig fingers, straw gushing from a split chest, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 环牙巨口 · 多牙生物

images.name: 角牙鳗 · 多牙生物

images.desc: 骑兽武者：披毛皮、戴狐首冠的草原萨满，骑在鬃毛蓬起的巨狼上，左手举起斑驳铜镜，右手执陶汤勺，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Beast rider: a steppe shaman in a fur-trimmed coat and fox-head headdress astride a shaggy grey wolf, holding up a battered bronze mirror and a clay soup ladle, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 兽角喇叭铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：喇叭口用一整段兽角做成的铳，铜丝与皮绳捆扎，角身裹着开裂的绿苔与干草，粗糙木柄雕出握纹，垂着一只陶制火药瓶，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: a blunderbuss with a flared barrel made from a whole animal horn, bound with brass wire and leather, wrapped in cracked green moss, a carved wooden grip and a clay powder flask on a cord, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 纸罩灯笼铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：整个枪身就是一只鼓起的暖橙纸灯笼，竹骨清晰可见，顶部伸出一根细铜嘴，底部接着木质扳机握把，纸面带几处焦痕并透出微光，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: the whole body is a swollen warm-orange paper lantern with visible bamboo ribs, a thin copper nozzle rising from the top, a wooden trigger grip at the base, scorch marks and a faint glow inside, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 活藤缠枝铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：由粗藤与木质茎纠缠成枪形的活体枪械，枪口是中空枝条并像花一样绽开，枪身沿路生着淡紫小花，握把盘成一圈树根，森林绿配灰紫花色，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: a living musket woven from thick vines and woody stems, the hollow twig muzzle splitting open like a blossom, pale lavender flowers along the barrel, the grip spiraling into woody roots, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 铁环链节铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：一串锈铁环与小黄铜管像脊椎一样串成的怪异枪械，前端散开成钟形喇叭口，后端是缠皮握把并垂着磨散的绳头，锈橙与暗黄铜配色，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: an absurd gun made of rusted iron rings and small brass tubes linked like a spine, opening at the front into a wide bell-shaped cluster, a leather-wrapped grip with frayed cord, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 陶壶闷药铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：圆滚滚的灰色陶壶改成的怪异枪械，肩部焊着一根细铁嘴，壶腹釉面开裂并沾着黑灰，侧面装着木制扳杆，通风孔里飘出一缕青烟，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: a squat bulbous firearm made from a round grey clay jar with a narrow iron spout welded to its shoulder, cracked glaze and soot stains, a carved wooden trigger lever and a wisp of smoke from a vent hole, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 算盘弹仓铳 · 怪异枪械
images.desc: 怪异枪械：弹仓是一副串着墨玉与骨珠的木算盘，珠子被锈弹簧推着往前走，细竹管枪身用蜡线绑在框架上，下方用绳吊着一只象牙色火药角，蜜色木配翠绿珠，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Bizarre firearm: a rifle whose magazine is a wooden abacus strung with dark jade and bone beads pushed forward by a rusted spring, a thin bamboo barrel lashed on with waxed twine, an ivory powder horn dangling below, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 外卖骑手 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代外卖骑手，亮黄蓝冲锋衣配反光马甲，白色头盔，一手持手机一手抓背包肩带，脚上是磨旧跑鞋，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Modern folk: a food-delivery rider in a bright yellow and blue windbreaker with reflective vest and white helmet, one hand holding a smartphone, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 咖啡师 · 都市小民

images.descEn: Modern folk: a barista in a dark green apron over a white rolled-sleeve shirt, holding a steel pour-over kettle and a small cup, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 健身教练 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代健身教练，橙色运动背心配黑色紧身裤，肩上扛一只哑铃，另一手竖大拇指，短马尾，笑容爽朗，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Modern folk: a fitness coach in an orange tank top and black leggings, a dumbbell on her shoulder and a thumbs up, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 通勤白领 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代通勤白领，藏青西装配白衬衫灰领带，黑色皮鞋，一手提棕色皮公文包戴着白色无线耳机，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Modern folk: an office commuter in a navy suit with white shirt and grey tie, holding a brown leather briefcase, white wireless earphones in, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 滑板青年 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代街头滑板青年，宽松淡紫卫衣配卡其工装裤，脚踩红白旧板鞋，一手拎着竖起的滑板，另一手插兜，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Modern folk: a street skater in an oversized lilac hoodie and khaki cargo pants, one foot on a worn red-and-white skateboard, other hand in pocket, transparent PNG, 1024×1024

images.name: 夜班司机 · 都市小民
images.desc: 都市小民：现代夜班网约车司机，墨绿飞行夹克罩灰色连帽卫衣，一手拿不锈钢保温杯一手拎充电线，有点困但友善，透明 PNG，1024×1024
images.descEn: Modern folk: a night-shift ride-hailing driver in a dark teal bomber jacket over a grey hoodie, holding a steel thermos and a phone charger cable, transparent PNG, 1024×1024
